status: RUN COMPLETE (judged block executed 2026-11-07). The criteria, gates, bar, seed block and decision table were frozen before the run and are unmodified; the verdict is the committed scorer's output on docs/rank_ordering_run.json. M1 is the sole criterion (Amendment 4) and the density ladder is reported as a characterization.
question: does ordering eligible candidates by source diversity, rather than by count, recover more of a sparse world's edges at the engine's own cap

design.world_family: 16 tags, the Gate 13 world family; |P_world| = 240 directed non-self pairs
design.cells_arithmetic: 2 arms x 2 caps x 5 densities x 8 seeds = 160
design.eligibility: every candidate row, including intra-cell co-occurrence rows; the density record varies eligibility and this one does not
design.exposure: fixed total exposure, the density record's primary scheme; the sensitivity scheme is not run and is not a licence to add cells
design.horizon: one horizon, identical in both arms at each density

control.name: global count-ranked top-k
control.rule: rank every eligible candidate by count and take the top k at the cap

diversity.name: diversity-first ordering
diversity.rule: greedy max-marginal-coverage over the source side: each slot takes the eligible candidate whose left-hand tag has the fewest already-selected outgoing edges, ties on count then a stable key

seeds.freshness: the first contiguous window of nine numbers at or after 20310201 that appears in no file under docs, tests, benchmarks, research-journal or papers; the bootstrap seed is the ninth and is not a world seed
seeds.consumed: recording this block makes it consumed for the corpus seed scan, which is the intended effect: a declared block is registered rather than left free to be reallocated

gates.G0_liveness: at rho_world = 0.1, at each cap, the two arms' selected sets differ on at least 7 of the 8 seeds
gates.G1_presence_ceiling: the world's edges present in memory over the world's edges equals 1.0 in every cell
gates.G2_arithmetic_consistency: every cell's covered and asserted counts reconcile with its coverage and precision, coverage and precision lie in [0, 1], and precision is reported beside rho_rank rather than gated on it
gates.G3_axis_live: mean rho_rank at rho_world = 0.8 exceeds mean rho_rank at rho_world = 0.1, at each cap
gates.G4_control_reproduces: mean control coverage at cap 20 and rho_world = 0.1 does not exceed 0.15
gates.G5_identity_at_density_1: a harness self-test on a synthetic population where every candidate is a true edge selects identical sets in both arms and returns exactly zero delta; it spends no engine cell
gates.void_rule: any gate failure voids the block and is reported as the gate; no criterion is read

criteria.M1_rule: mean Delta at cap 20 and rho_world = 0.1, where Delta = diversity coverage - control coverage per seed, is at least the bar and its 95% bootstrap interval's lower bound is above zero
criteria.M1_bar_provenance: declared before any cell, not computed from a run: 0.15 of the world's 24 edges at the sparsest level is at least a sixth of the world recovered beyond control, and the control's sampling expectation at that density is 20 x 0.1 / 24, about 0.083
criteria.underpowered_rule: if M1 fails and its interval is wider than 0.30, the block is reported as underpowered and no line is closed; a wide interval is not a negative result
criteria.M2_withdrawn: Amendment 4 (2026-11-07): withdrawn. No endpoint could both vary with density and fail here. The precision difference in differences at cap 20 is zero or negative on all eight designed seeds, because the precision gap is set by the eight crowded sources and does not vary with density. The coverage gap varies only through |W|: at cap 20 the dense-end gap is bounded by 20/192, so with M1's 0.15 bar the difference in differences is at least 0.0625 on every integer-coverage seed and the old 0.05 bar could not fail while M1 passed. M1 is the sole criterion; the coverage and precision gaps by density are reported as a characterization and are not scored.
criteria.density_profile_rule: reported, not gated: coverage and precision gaps at cap 20 for every density, with the number of seeds whose coverage gap is positive; no threshold is applied to the ladder

amendments.was: no cell reports precision above its own rho_rank
amendments.now: every cell reconciles covered, asserted, coverage and precision, and precision is reported beside rho_rank
amendments.why: the original gate was unsatisfiable for any informative ranker: rho_rank is the base rate of the population, so a rule that selects better than chance necessarily reports precision above it. As written, G2 would have voided exactly the result the block exists to detect. Amended before any cell ran.

amendments.was: the difference in differences of coverage, flagged as an interaction
amendments.now: the difference in differences of precision at cap 20
amendments.why: coverage is divided by |W|, which grows eightfold across the ladder while the cap is fixed, so a coverage gap is mechanically forced to shrink with density and M2 would have been satisfied by the denominator rather than by the mechanism. Precision is normalized by the budget and tends to 1 in both arms at density 1, so its collapse is the interaction the design claims. Amended before any cell ran; M1 is unchanged.

amendments.was: every cell emitted its intra-cell pairs as filler, so all sixteen sources were crowded
amendments.now: two of the four cells emit filler, so eight sources are crowded and eight are free
amendments.why: with every source crowded the diversity arm could reach no world edge at either cap: after one pick per source its count tie-break returns to filler. The smoke run proved it and the reach gate made it refuse. The change is to the world the run ticket builds, not to either arm's rule, and it was made before any judged cell.

amendments.was: the precision difference in differences at cap 20, rho 0.1 minus rho 0.8, at least 0.05 with a positive lower bound and a wider gap at the sparse end on 7 of 8 seeds
amendments.now: withdrawn. M1 is the sole criterion; the coverage and precision gaps by density are reported as a characterization and are not scored
amendments.why: the precision DiD is zero or negative on all eight designed seeds: at cap 20 the precision gap is set by the eight crowded sources, a count that does not vary with density, and at rho 0.8 every non-filler row is a world edge. The only density-varying quantity is the coverage gap, and it varies through the world size: at cap 20 the dense-end gap is bounded by 20/192, so with M1's 0.15 bar the difference in differences is at least 0.0625 on every integer-coverage seed and the 0.05 bar cannot fail while M1 passes. A criterion that cannot fail is decoration, so the interaction is withdrawn rather than replaced by the denominator; the ladder is reported and the decision table is level-based. Withdrawn before any judged cell, on structural grounds and two non-judged smoke pools.

smoke.label: SMOKE, NOT A JUDGED CELL, NOT EVIDENCE
audits_predicted: presence is 1.0: every world edge is a row in memory
control coverage at cap 20 stays under the 0.15 ceiling
the two arms select different rows at cap 20
precision stays under the Gate 13 maximum 0.3438
rho_rank is the true-edge share of the pool
every selected row exists in the pool
smoke.defect: both arms cover zero world edges at caps 20 and 40. The 48 intra-cell filler rows carry counts 12-17, three per source across all 16 sources, while the world's rows carry 3-9 and the best ranks 51; the diversity ordering breaks ties on count, so after one pick per source its remaining 4 (cap 20) or 24 (cap 40) picks are more filler. Coverage is 0 in both arms, so Delta is 0 by construction at the pre-registered primary point; M1 cannot pass and its interval has width 0, which is not underpowered, so the only reachable verdict is ORDERING NOT THE LEVER -- a decisive negative produced by the world's construction, not by the ordering basis.
smoke.why_the_audits_missed_it: the liveness audit asks whether the arms select different rows, and they do, but the difference is which filler rows are chosen, not whether either arm reaches a world row. No audit compared either arm's selection to the world at the primary point, so liveness was satisfied without reach.
smoke.recommendation: do not run the block. The owner decides: concentrate the crowding on a subset of sources so spreading can escape it, drop the count tie-break (a different, separately disclosed rule), or move the question to the density and eligibility record. A third ordering variant added after the fact is what the design record's stop condition forbids.

repair.what: the intra-cell filler is emitted from two of the four cells (FILLER_CELLS = 2) instead of all four, so eight sources are crowded and eight are free; neither arm's ordering rule changed
repair.why: with every source crowded the diversity ordering spends one pick per source and then its count tie-break returns to filler, so both arms cover zero world edges at both caps and the block can only return a decisive false negative. The crowding is a property of the world the run ticket builds, not of the ordering basis the block tests.

smoke.label: SMOKE AFTER THE REPAIR, NOT A JUDGED CELL, NOT EVIDENCE

finding_M2.rule: M2: precision difference in differences, rho 0.1 minus rho 0.8 at cap 20
finding_M2.why: at cap 20 the precision gap is set by how many crowded sources the spread must spend on, which is the same at every density, and at rho 0.8 every non-filler row is a world edge, so the gap there is at least as wide as at 0.1. The difference in differences is therefore zero or negative on every seed, and the registered direction (wider at the sparse end) cannot occur.
finding_M2.consequence: standing alone M2 could only return ORDERING HELPS, GRADIENT ABSENT, so the block would have rested on a criterion that cannot fail; Amendment 4 withdraws it and M1 alone decides
finding_M2.resolution: Amendment 4 withdraws M2 and makes M1 the sole criterion; the ladder is reported as a characterization (not_run.repair.finding_M2 keeps the evidence)
